newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Simsen Metals says in acquisition talks.
newsitem.headline: Simsen Metals says in acquisition talks.

text.p: Nonferrous metals trader Simsen Metals (Holdings) Ltd said on Friday it was in talks regarding possible acquisitions.
"The company is currently considering a proposal in relation to some possible acquistions and is in negotiations regarding such acquisitions," the company said in a statement.
"Such negotiations in respect of possible acquisitions are being carried out and have not yet been completed and no binding terms have been agreed by relevant parties," it said.
The company said it was not possible to give firm indications on the timing of the purchase or whether they would be proceeded with. The statement gave no further details.
Simsen Metals shares gained HK$0.02 to HK$0.95 in early trade.
